title: Portfolio - LLM Eval Harness API
description: Local LLM eval harness: receives an eval run with inline golden cases, runs a GATED subject-under-test, scores each output deterministic-first with the 5-type assertion taxonomy (schema/range/format/absence/masking), then grades residual subjective dimensions (1..5 groundedness/relevance/helpfulness/safety) with a GATED LLM-as-judge. SUT gate: sutMode:'workflow' grades the LIVE product-feedback sibling (6Gc3wmri0tJre07B) as a black box over its real webhook (extracts response.theme as the actual output, onError:continueRegularOutput -> sutSource:'error', passed=false on an unreachable sibling); anything else uses the deterministic stub SUT (the default). Judge gate: judgeSource:'ollama' calls a live local llama3.2:3b (format:json) per case with schema-validation + deterministic fallback (judgeSource:'fallback', passed=false) on bad/unreachable output, anything else uses the deterministic stub judge (the default). Computes judge-human agreement over an optional humanLabel calibration slice and sets judgeTrust high (>=0.8) else low. Aggregates pass-rate + per-rubric mean and emits a redacted audit event.
integrations: Live workflow subject-under-test (sutMode:workflow grades product-feedback 6Gc3wmri0tJre07B as a black box) with graceful non-fatal failure
Live Ollama LLM-as-judge (llama3.2:3b, judgeSource:ollama) with deterministic fallback
sutMode: stub (default) | workflow (live, grades product-feedback as a black box)
buildMechanism: sdk-standalone (@n8n/workflow-sdk) compiled to JSON, deployed via n8n public REST API (no MCP). See docs/adr/0002-deploy-via-rest-api-without-mcp.md.
notes: v0.3.0: added a GATED subject-under-test. A visual IF gate ('SUT Mode = Workflow?') routes sutMode:'workflow' to a fan-out (one item per golden case) -> httpRequest POSTing each case's feedback object to the LIVE product-feedback sibling (6Gc3wmri0tJre07B) at /webhook/portfolio/product-feedback-intelligence (onError:continueRegularOutput so an unreachable/inactive sibling is non-fatal) -> parse node that extracts response.theme (+ sentiment/urgency) as the case's ACTUAL output and marks sutSource:'error' when no theme comes back (so the deterministic exact-match fails, passed=false — a broken sibling never silently passes). Anything else uses the deterministic stub SUT (the default, keeping verify:live offline + reproducible). The sibling is graded as a BLACK BOX over its real HTTP endpoint (ADR-0003), not by importing its code. Normalize now preserves OBJECT inputs (the feedback payload) so the structured body survives to the SUT step. v0.2.0's gated Ollama judge + judge-human calibration are unchanged. Deployed live (id IhmmthDFMKdDbgvp, 26 nodes, active) and verified 2026-05-30: verify:static/json/live green (30-assertion stub suite, node floor 26); verify:judge green (live Ollama judge, agreement 1.0, judgeTrust:high); verify:connected activates product-feedback and grades it live over a 6-case slice (feedback-bug-negative/feature-request/praise/pricing/performance/usability) returning sutMode:'workflow', passRate 1.0 (all 6 live themes matched expected); an unreachable-sibling run returned HTTP 200 passed:false without crashing. DEFERRED: SUT model fan-out (sutMode:'model'), regression-vs-previous-run.
